title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj
description: Qual será o seu papel? Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas. Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente. Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes. Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem. Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa. Esperamos que você tenha: Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio). Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk). Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD. Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch). Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts. Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial): Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure). Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker. Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura. Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure) Contratação: PJ.

fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM;

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and "Control Tower" operational models. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Data Engineer Revenue Management
description: Data Engineer Revenue Management Remote (send your resume in English) A Iron Mountain está em busca de um Data Engineer Revenue Management motivado(a) e com fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês para se juntar à nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management (Gestão de Receita Global). Neste cargo, você será responsável por projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis para garantir dados limpos e acessíveis, transformando dados brutos em insights que impulsionam a melhor segmentação de clientes. Você fará parte de uma equipe de alto impacto dedicada a direcionar a estratégia de preços global para atingir nossas metas de receita e lucro, exigindo coordenação entre as regiões da América do Norte, Europa e América Latina. O Que Você Fará Desenvolver Arquiteturas de Dados Escaláveis: Projetar e manter pipelines de Extraction, Transformation, and Loading (Extração, Transformação e Carregamento - ETL) integrando dados de sistemas operacionais globais usando tecnologias Amazon Web Services (AWS) e Structured Query Language (SQL). Otimizar Processos e Automação: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos internos, redesenhando a infraestrutura para maior escalabilidade e automatizando processos manuais para fornecer conjuntos de dados selecionados para análises e painéis operacionais. Garantir a Excelência Operacional e Governança: Monitorar o desempenho e a qualidade dos pipelines, implementando testes automatizados e padrões de governança de dados alinhados às políticas de segurança da informação da empresa. O candidato ideal terá: fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês 3 a 5 anos ou mais de experiência em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines em ambientes corporativos de grande escala. Sólido conhecimento técnico em modelagem de dados, Structured Query Language (SQL) e proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python ou Scala. Capacidade comprovada em processamento de dados distribuídos (ex: Spark) e no uso de plataformas em nuvem para extração e carregamento de conjuntos de dados complexos. Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada. O Que Oferecemos (Benefícios) Localização: Opções de trabalho remoto ou híbrido para apoiar o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar: Programa de férias e dias de folga remunerados. Segurança e Futuro: Planos abrangentes de saúde, bem-estar e previdência privada. Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Oportunidades de aprendizado constante e crescimento profissional em uma organização líder global. Pronto para ajudar a proteger e desbloquear o valor da informação? Candidate-se hoje mesmo para integrar nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management e construir as bases de dados do futuro!

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Legal Assistant
description: Position Overview Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters. Key Responsibilities Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation Coordinate with internal teams including eDiscovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion Required Qualifications and Skills Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency in common office and document management software tools Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus About Gemean Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP At International Digital Partners (IDP), we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams, and that’s where you come in. About the Role We are looking for a Technical Recruiter, highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles. Key Responsibilities Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
Source talent proactively via LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish. Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
Contribute to processimprovement and employer branding initiatives. Requirements Must-Haves: 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;
Solid understanding of tech stacks, tools, and roles (e.G., Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps, Data, QA);
Fluency (B2)in English is a must;
Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required Experience using ATS platforms (e.G., Manatal, Greenhouse, Bullhorn) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter;
Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
Strong organizationaland interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset. Nice-to-Haves: Background in tech consulting or staffing;
Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
Knowledge ofinternational hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams. What We Offer Fully remote, international working environment Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture Access to innovative global projects with high impact Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Ms D365 Crm Functional Consultant
description: We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.About TMF GroupTMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‐critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.Discover the RoleWe are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365). The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‐oriented, self‐driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.Key ResponsibilitiesGather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.Deliver end‐user training and provide ongoing functional support.Maintain up‐to‐date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.Key RequirementsExperience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.Experience with version 8.0 or later.Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET.Strong understanding of D365 CRM's data model, security model and configuration options.Excellent analytical, problem‐solving and critical‐thinking skills.Strong verbal and written communication skills.Ability to work independently or in a team environment.What's in It for You?Career DevelopmentOpportunities for internal mobility and career progression.Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.Making an ImpactDirect contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.A Supportive EnvironmentA strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‐life balance.An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.At TMF Group, our people define who we are. We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

Capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas;
Interesse por inovação e evolução contínua na plataforma;
Organização e autonomia na gestão do trabalho. Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir Big enough to deliver – small enough to care. #VempraGFT

title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep, you read that right. Apply now!

title: Ruby On Rails Developer
description: Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote) We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States. THE ROLE Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent. You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments) Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity BONUS POINTS Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations) Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines WHAT YOU'LL DO Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations) Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams YOUR IMPACT Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Analista De Infraestrutura Azure Sr - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas. ♿ Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece. Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade Arquiteto(a) de Infraestrutura Sobre a oportunidade: Atividades: - Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.
- Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.
- Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).
- Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.
- Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).
- Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights) Diferencial desejado: - Conhecimento em estratégias de migração (Cloud Adoption Framework).
- Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD (Azure DevOps).
- Certificações: AZ-104 (Administrador) e AZ-900 (Fundamentos).
- Grande Diferencial: Certificação AZ-305 (Architect Design) e AZ-700 (Networking). Qualidade pessoais desejadas: - Capacidade analítica: Lidar com grandes volumes de dados exige identificar padrões, tendências e anomalias.Extrair insights de informações complexas é indispensável.
- Atenção aos detalhes: Pequenas variações nos dados podem indicar problemas sérios. É necessário ser meticuloso e preciso na análise de informações.
- Habilidade de resolução de problemas: - Identificar a raiz de problemas e desenvolver soluções é essencial.
- Pensar de forma lógica e sistemática para resolver desafios complexos.
- Comunicação eficaz: Comunicar informações técnicas de forma clara é vital para colaborar com equipes diversas. Explicar conceitos complexos de forma compreensível para diferentes públicos.
- Proatividade: Antecipar problemas e tomar medidas preventivas.
- Identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar soluções proativamente.
- Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão: Incidentes críticos exigem respostas rápidas e eficazes. Manter a calma e tomar decisões assertivas em situações de alta pressão.
- Aprendizado contínuo: A tecnologia evolui constantemente, exigindo aprendizado de novas ferramentas e técnicas. Curiosidade e desejo de se manter atualizado.
- Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar, compartilhar informações e auxiliar colegas é essencial para alcançar objetivos. Experiência anterior desejada: - Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.
- Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.
- Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).
- Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.
- Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA). Habilidades Técnicas: - Azure - AKS - AZ-104 - AZ-900 - estratégias de migração - IaC - Terraform - Bicep - On-premises - SaaS - Containers - PaaS Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto Benefícios | Clube da Four

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing: Turing is one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world's leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview: We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset. What You'll Do: Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience. Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations. Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset. Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams. Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle. What we expect from you: Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred 4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies. Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
advanced degree is a plus. Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have. Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus. Previous experience with Workday is a plus. Soft Skills Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Strategic mindset with strong execution. Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management. Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices. What we offer: Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies. A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community. A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career. Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: Product Owner
description: Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL We’re proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing SaaS business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Join a scaling, globally-focused SaaS business at an exciting stage of growth Work directly with an experienced and passionate leadership team Have real influence over product direction and client success Fully remote role with international collaboration Be instrumental in shaping how clients experience and succeed with the platform If you’re a product-minded professional who thrives on solving real client problems and driving meaningful outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Accounting Manager
description: About UsEstablished in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key ResponsibilitiesOversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.Implement and monitor ACAM (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.RequirementsExperience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. title: Analista De Infraestrutura Azure Sr - Remoto
description:

- Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.
- Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).
- Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.
- Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).
- Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights) Diferencial desejado: - Conhecimento em estratégias de migração (Cloud Adoption Framework).
- Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD (Azure DevOps).
- Certificações: AZ-104 (Administrador) e AZ-900 (Fundamentos).
- Grande Diferencial: Certificação AZ-305 (Architect Design) e AZ-700 (Networking). Qualidade pessoais desejadas: - Capacidade analítica: Lidar com grandes volumes de dados exige identificar padrões, tendências e anomalias.Extrair insights de informações complexas é indispensável.
- Atenção aos detalhes: Pequenas variações nos dados podem indicar problemas sérios. É necessário ser meticuloso e preciso na análise de informações.
- Habilidade de resolução de problemas: - Identificar a raiz de problemas e desenvolver soluções é essencial.
- Pensar de forma lógica e sistemática para resolver desafios complexos.
- Comunicação eficaz: Comunicar informações técnicas de forma clara é vital para colaborar com equipes diversas. Explicar conceitos complexos de forma compreensível para diferentes públicos.
- Proatividade: Antecipar problemas e tomar medidas preventivas.
- Identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar soluções proativamente.
- Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão: Incidentes críticos exigem respostas rápidas e eficazes. Manter a calma e tomar decisões assertivas em situações de alta pressão.
- Aprendizado contínuo: A tecnologia evolui constantemente, exigindo aprendizado de novas ferramentas e técnicas. Curiosidade e desejo de se manter atualizado.
- Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar, compartilhar informações e auxiliar colegas é essencial para alcançar objetivos. Experiência anterior desejada: - Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.
- Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.
- Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).
- Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.
- Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA). Habilidades Técnicas: - Azure - AKS - AZ-104 - AZ-900 - estratégias de migração - IaC - Terraform - Bicep - On-premises - SaaS - Containers - PaaS Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto Benefícios | Clube da Four

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal! Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível: Requisitos e Atividades - Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.
- Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.

title: Accounting Manager
description: About UsEstablished in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities- Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.- Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.- Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.- Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.- Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.- Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.- Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.- Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.Requirements- Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.- Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.- Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.- Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.- Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.- Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Llm Scientist

title: System Architect
description: Project Description: Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration. Responsibilities: Define and own end-to-end vision system architecture (sensor → ISP → CV/ML → application layer). Translate product and UX requirements into scalable technical solutions. Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals. Architect reusable, modular CV/ML frameworks across multiple product SKUs. Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, cost, and thermal limits. Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment. Architect heterogeneous compute utilization (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP). Define system KPIs: latency, FPS, power, memory, boot time, and robustness. Lead technology selection for inference engines, frameworks, and hardware platforms. Guide SoC bring-up and performance validation for vision pipelines. Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability. Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies. Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams. Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance. Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations. Mandatory Skills Description: - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred). 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems. Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI. Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact). Strong embedded system architecture experience. Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge. Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration. Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs. Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures. Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies. Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills. Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Analista Digital Analytics - Junior | Varejo
description:
Descrição da vagaA FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa com perfil de Digital Analytics Junior, para apoiar a construção e evolução de mapeamento de coleta de dados WEB e APP, implementação e manutenção de tags de parceiros de Mídia e CRM no GTM, além ajudar em investigações e análises no dia a dia na interface do GA4 e em dados brutos, em parceria com uma das maiores empresas de solução digital, voltada ao E-commerce que tem atuação em mais de 60 anos de história, com mais de 1.000 lojas físicas, 28 centros de distribuição e mais de 33 milhões de produtos no marketplace.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesApoiar a execução e documentação de mapas de coleta (GA4 / Mixpanel)Ajudar na implementação e validação de eventos via GTMApoiar análises simples de funil, conversão e comportamento no e-commerceTrabalhar junto com times de Marketing, Produto e GrowthRequisitos e qualificaçõesSkills Essenciais: Ser proativo, receptivo e esforçado;
Ser organizado para lidar com entregas;
Conhecimento básico em GA4 e/ou MixpanelNoções de Google Tag ManagerMentalidade analítica e interesse em dados e métricasVontade real de aprender e se desenvolver em Digital Analytics / Dados Diferenciais (nao obrigatório)Noções de SQLInteresse ou contato com CRO / testes A/BExperiência acadêmica ou projetos pessoais em dados ou analytics

title: Senior Collections Policy Analyst
description:
Senior Collections Policy Analyst What You’ll Do Analyze the behavior of customers with short-, medium-, and long-term delinquencies to identify opportunities for improvement;
Create and refine data-driven collections policies to reduce risk and increase recovery;
Use SQL and Python to extract insights and generate strategic reports;
Explain to the business and sales teams why analytical strategies work and demonstrate the value of the solutions;
Work closely with the Data Science and Operations teams. What we’re looking for Experience: Previous experience with data analysis focused on collections or credit risk;
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, BigQuery, and Python;
Practical Approach: Ability to translate numbers into actions that solve customer problems;
Communication: Ability to explain complex results in a simple way to different teams;
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or related fields. Differentiators Knowledge of discount policies, portfolio write-offs, and pricing English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Analista Sénior de Políticas de Cobranças O que irá fazer Analisar o comportamento dos clientes com incumprimentos a curto, médio e longo prazo para identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
Criar e aperfeiçoar políticas de cobranças baseadas em dados para reduzir o risco e aumentar a recuperação;
Utilizar SQL e Python para extrair insights e gerar relatórios estratégicos;
Explicar às equipas comerciais e de vendas por que razão as estratégias analíticas funcionam e demonstrar o valor das soluções;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipas de Ciência de Dados e Operações. O que procuramos Experiência: Experiência anterior em análise de dados focada em cobranças ou risco de crédito;
Competências técnicas: Proficiência em SQL, BigQuery e Python;
Abordagem prática: Capacidade de traduzir números em ações que resolvam os problemas dos clientes;
Comunicação: Capacidade de explicar resultados complexos de forma simples a diferentes equipas;
Formação: Licenciatura em Matemática, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins. Diferenciais Conhecimento de políticas de descontos, baixas de carteira e precificação;
Inglês.

title: Siebel Consultant
description:
A PrimeIT é uma empresa de referência, com 18 anos de experiência na prestação de serviços tecnológicos de IT, Telecomunicações e Engenharia. Especializados em Team Extension, Managed Services, Custom Software e Nearshore, contamos actualmente com uma equipa de mais de 2350 profissionais que colaboram em projectos nacionais e internacionais nas mais diversas tecnologias. Estamos à procura de um Siebel Consultant! O que procuramos? Mais de 2 anos de experiência em Siebel (8.1.X), com foco em desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções CRM. Experiência em PL/SQL para desenvolvimento e otimização de queries e procedimentos em bases de dados Oracle. Conhecimentos de IBM DataStage para processos ETL e integração de dados. Experiência em Shell Script em ambientes Unix/Linux para automação e suporte a processos aplicacionais. Responsabilidades: Realizar análise, desenho, implementação e testes de melhorias e correções no CRM One. Avaliar impactos técnicos e funcionais nas aplicações Siebel (8.1.15) e nos processos ETL em DataStage. Garantir a qualidade das entregas de software, assegurando conformidade com requisitos funcionais e técnicos. Colaborar com equipas funcionais e operacionais na implementação de evoluções solicitadas. O que oferecemos? Integração numa empresa de dimensão internacional com presença em mais de 50 cidades no mundo;
Formação constante nasmais recentes e inovadoras tecnologias – Prime Academy;
Acompanhamento e progressão de carreira. Envia o teu CV e junta-te à equipa Prime!

title: Railway Test & Validation Engineer (Rolling Stock) – Relocation To Spain

description: Position OverviewAs a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals.
